gloss: to sneer at; to ridicule; to mock

definitions.gloss: to sneer at; to ridicule; to mock
definitions.explanation: To laugh at someone or something with contempt or scorn. Stronger and more hostile than simply laughing at someone.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{嘲笑|あざわら}った。
{人|ひと}の{努力|どりょく}を{嘲笑|あざわら}うべきではない。
examples.english: You shouldn't mock other people's efforts.

examples.japanese: {周囲|しゅうい}に{嘲笑|あざわら}われても、{彼女|かのじょ}は{自分|じぶん}の{夢|ゆめ}を{諦|あきら}めなかった。
examples.english: Even though those around her ridiculed her, she did not give up on her dream.

notes:
{嘲笑|あざわら}う is a transitive godan verb. It carries a strongly negative nuance — contemptuous or scornful laughter directed at someone.

ASPECT (ている):
{嘲笑|あざわら}っている describes the ongoing act of mocking someone.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～を{嘲笑|あざわら}う (to mock someone/something)
- ～に{嘲笑|あざわら}われる (to be ridiculed by someone — passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}を{嘲笑|あざわら}う (to mock a person)
- {失敗|しっぱい}を{嘲笑|あざわら}う (to sneer at a failure)
- {嘲笑|あざわら}うような{態度|たいど} (a mocking attitude)

RELATED WORDS:
{笑|わら}う is neutral laughter, {馬鹿|ばか}にする is general making fun of. {嘲笑|あざわら}う is specifically contemptuous, scornful laughter — stronger and more literary than either.
